purpose: PRODUCTION ONLY. Attaches each approved Grade 6 quiz to the Grade 6 curriculum topic that already exists in the production content database (the owner's Homework PDFs taxonomy, Topics 1-8). Existing topics keep their titles and numbering; no topic is created, renamed or moved. The quiz cards read 'Grade 6 / Topic N: <existing topic title>' with the quiz's verbatim PDF title underneath. Used by scripts/invoke-quiz-pdfs-production.ps1 -TopicMap only after owner approval.
